Last Wednesday, Amy and Grace went to the school garden. Amy plays basketball with Grace every Wednesday. Both of them like chicken and juice. Also, the Israeli visitor loved the local street food.
The school garden is one of the best places in the city. Amy learned a lot about science. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. The hall of residence shuts at midnight.
Amy spent the weekend at the zoo. Grace is interested in swimming. Life is full of small surprises. Best of all, study leave starts next Monday.
Amy hopes to visit Toronto one day. Amy is going to travel to Toronto in July. They took many photos at the reading room.
